name: suggest_translation
description: Input is natural-language text (a full sentence or phrase, not a URL/path/identifier) written in a language foreign to the user's UI language Chinese, so the launcher suggests translating it to Chinese. Also for explicit translation requests (翻译 / fanyi / translate ...).

name: ask_ai
description: Input is Chinese natural-language text addressed to an assistant: a question, request, or instruction.

name: open_url
description: Input is a web URL (http/https, host or host/path, optionally port).

name: open_path
description: Input is a file system path: Windows absolute like C:\Users\name\file.ext, UNC \\server\share\file, or unix /usr/local/bin/tool, usually with a slash or drive letter and often an extension.

name: no_intent
description: Input is an app name, search keyword, code identifier, shell command, email, UUID, color code, IP, or anything else meant for the search box - no special action to suggest.
